title: Russian Chicken Breast Biryani
description: This unique recipe is a flavorful Biryani dish featuring yogurt-marinated Russian chicken breast, slow-cooked in a paleo-friendly tandoor. It's light, aerated, and perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together yogurt, ginger paste, cilantro, lime juice, and 1 tsp of salt. Add the chicken breasts and mix well to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.

Heat 1 tbsp of coconut oil in a tandoor or a large skillet over medium-high heat. Remove the chicken from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off. Cook the chicken for 5-6 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165 F.
In a large bowl, combine basmati rice, cumin powder, garam masala, salt, and cayenne pepper. Mix well.
Add 2 cups of water to the rice mixture and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and fluffy.

To assemble the biryani, place a layer of cooked rice at the bottom of a large serving dish. Arrange a layer of cooked chicken on top of the rice. Repeat this process, ending with a layer of rice on top.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.
